name: B10-0431/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex XVII to Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council concerning the Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) as regards lead in gunshot
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is the European Parliament's opinion, not a change in the law. It asks the European Commission to withdraw its plan to ban lead in gunshot and to come back with a new one. Members say the Commission has not shown the ban is fair and workable. They want proof that lead-free ammunition is safe in existing guns, that small shooting clubs can afford the new rules, and that hunting and defence industries will not be harmed.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament rejects the draft ban and asks for a new proposal with a fuller impact assessment.
- **Who it affects:** Hunters, sport shooters, shooting clubs, gun and ammunition makers, and Member States.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must decide whether to withdraw the draft and draft a revised version.
